# MCP Tools Reference — xstockstrat-agent

This skill projects the maintainer runbook (`docs/runbooks/mcp-tools.md`) into a form a **wire-connected agent can consume**. Load only what you need:

- **Connecting / auth** → `reference/transport-auth.md`
- **Cross-tool workflows & config keys** → `reference/usage-patterns.md`
- **A specific tool** → find it below and open its `reference/tools/<name>.md`.

Do not read every reference file up front — open one tool file at a time.

## Tools

| Tool | Summary | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| `list_signal_sources` | Lists active signal sources registered in `xstockstrat-ingest`. | `reference/tools/list_signal_sources.md` |
| `extract_email_content` | Extracts raw text from email attachments (PDF or plain text) or gated URLs for a registered source. | `reference/tools/extract_email_content.md` |
| `extract_website_content` | Fetches and returns raw text from a registered website source. | `reference/tools/extract_website_content.md` |
| `ingest_signal` | Ingests a trading signal into `xstockstrat-ingest`. | `reference/tools/ingest_signal.md` |
| `emit_alert` | Emits an alert directly via `xstockstrat-notify`. | `reference/tools/emit_alert.md` |
| `run_backtest` | Triggers a backtest via `xstockstrat-analysis`. | `reference/tools/run_backtest.md` |
| `screen_symbols` | Scans an explicit universe of symbols via `xstockstrat-analysis` `ScreenSymbols` (feature 060) and returns ranked candidates. | `reference/tools/screen_symbols.md` |
| `manage_strategy` | Registers, updates, deactivates, or **reactivates** a stored strategy definition in `xstockstrat-analysis`. | `reference/tools/manage_strategy.md` |
| `get_strategy` | Reads a stored strategy's full definition from `xstockstrat-analysis`. | `reference/tools/get_strategy.md` |
| `manage_formula` | Registers, updates, or deletes a custom formula definition in `xstockstrat-indicators`. | `reference/tools/manage_formula.md` |
| `get_formula` | Fetches one custom formula's stored definition from `xstockstrat-indicators`. | `reference/tools/get_formula.md` |
| `list_formulas` | Lists custom formula definitions from `xstockstrat-indicators`. | `reference/tools/list_formulas.md` |
| `list_fundamental_metrics` | Lists the fundamental-metrics catalog for formula authoring (read-only, feature 205). | `reference/tools/list_fundamental_metrics.md` |
| `manage_signal_source` | Registers, updates, reactivates, or deactivates a signal source in `xstockstrat-ingest`. | `reference/tools/manage_signal_source.md` |
| `run_fundamentals_scan` | Manually triggers the fundamentals signal producer via `xstockstrat-analysis` `RunFundamentalsScan` | `reference/tools/run_fundamentals_scan.md` |
| `trigger_backfill` | Triggers a historical backfill via `xstockstrat-ingest` `TriggerBackfill` (feature 066). | `reference/tools/trigger_backfill.md` |
| `get_backfill_status` | Checks one backfill job or lists recent jobs via ingest `GetBackfillStatus` / `ListBackfillJobs`. | `reference/tools/get_backfill_status.md` |
| `cancel_backfill` | Cancels a queued/running backfill job via ingest `CancelBackfill`. | `reference/tools/cancel_backfill.md` |
| `test_formula` | Dry-runs **inline** formula source in the indicators sandbox via `ExecuteFormula`, **registering | `reference/tools/test_formula.md` |
| `list_strategies` | Lists stored strategy definitions via analysis `ListStrategyDefinitions` (feature 087). | `reference/tools/list_strategies.md` |
| `list_opportunities` | Lists the caller's ranked Decide-queue opportunities via analysis `ListOpportunities` with the | `reference/tools/list_opportunities.md` |
| `get_config` | Read a namespace's current config values from `xstockstrat-config`. | `reference/tools/get_config.md` |
| `list_config_keys` | List the config keys registered for a namespace, **metadata only — no values**. | `reference/tools/list_config_keys.md` |
| `set_config` | Write **one** config value — **including `is_secret` keys** (PR #994). | `reference/tools/set_config.md` |
| `get_user_metadata` | Fetch the calling user's own profile metadata from `xstockstrat-identity`. | `reference/tools/get_user_metadata.md` |
| `set_user_metadata` | Partial-update the calling user's own profile metadata. | `reference/tools/set_user_metadata.md` |
| `list_watchlists` | List the calling user's **own** watchlists from `xstockstrat-portfolio` (read-only, paginated). | `reference/tools/list_watchlists.md` |
| `get_watchlist` | Fetch one of the caller's watchlists, including its stocks, from `xstockstrat-portfolio` (read-only). | `reference/tools/get_watchlist.md` |
| `manage_watchlist` | Create, update, or delete one of the caller's watchlists in `xstockstrat-portfolio`. | `reference/tools/manage_watchlist.md` |
| `manage_watchlist_symbols` | Add, remove, or bulk-assign a strategy to stocks on one of the caller's watchlists in | `reference/tools/manage_watchlist_symbols.md` |
| `manage_offline_account` | Manage a manually-tracked **OFFLINE** account and its orders in `xstockstrat-trading` (feature 157). | `reference/tools/manage_offline_account.md` |
| `manage_account` | Manage **BROKER accounts** (Alpaca / IBKR) in `xstockstrat-trading` (feature 164, resume added by | `reference/tools/manage_account.md` |
| `list_accounts` | List the **caller's own** accounts — broker **and** offline together (read-only, feature 164). | `reference/tools/list_accounts.md` |
| `get_positions` | List **all positions** for the calling user across all accounts — broker and offline (read-only, | `reference/tools/get_positions.md` |
| `get_positions_by_account_id` | List positions for a **single account** owned by the calling user (read-only, feature 169). | `reference/tools/get_positions_by_account_id.md` |
| `query_bars` | Query stored **daily OHLCV bars** for a symbol from `xstockstrat-marketdata` (read-only, feature 204). | `reference/tools/query_bars.md` |
| `query_fundamentals` | Query a symbol's **fundamentals** from `xstockstrat-marketdata` (read-only, feature 204). | `reference/tools/query_fundamentals.md` |
| `manage_user` | Administer users (**ADMIN only**, feature 183). | `reference/tools/manage_user.md` |
| `list_users` | List all users (**ADMIN only**, read-only, feature 183). | `reference/tools/list_users.md` |
| `get_user` | Read one user by id (**ADMIN only**, read-only, feature 183). | `reference/tools/get_user.md` |
| `admin_get_user_metadata` | Read **any** user's profile metadata by `user_id` (**ADMIN only**, read-only, feature 183). | `reference/tools/admin_get_user_metadata.md` |
| `admin_set_user_metadata` | Partial-update **any** user's profile metadata by `user_id` (**ADMIN only**, feature 183). | `reference/tools/admin_set_user_metadata.md` |

## Database Tools (Admin-only)

| Tool | Summary | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| `db_list_schemas` | List all database schemas. | `reference/tools/db_list_schemas.md` |
| `db_list_objects` | List objects (tables, views, sequences, etc.) within a schema. | `reference/tools/db_list_objects.md` |
| `db_get_object_details` | Get DDL definition and statistics for a named database object. | `reference/tools/db_get_object_details.md` |
| `db_execute_sql` | Execute a SQL statement via the `xstockstrat_agent` DML role. | `reference/tools/db_execute_sql.md` |
| `db_explain_query` | Get the EXPLAIN (query execution plan) output for a SQL query. | `reference/tools/db_explain_query.md` |
| `db_get_top_queries` | Get the top queries by total execution time from `pg_stat_statements`. | `reference/tools/db_get_top_queries.md` |
| `db_analyze_workload_indexes` | Recommend indexes based on workload patterns captured in `pg_stat_statements`. | `reference/tools/db_analyze_workload_indexes.md` |
| `db_analyze_query_indexes` | Recommend indexes for a specific SQL query. | `reference/tools/db_analyze_query_indexes.md` |
| `db_analyze_db_health` | Run comprehensive database health checks (connections, bloat, replication lag, slow queries, etc.). | `reference/tools/db_analyze_db_health.md` |
